reference.type: native pptx pitch book, financing deck type, same master as scenario 1
reference.notes: A section of this kind once read as samey to a rater: three of five pages set a table beside a chart.

brief: Five-page financing section for Streamline Media's CFO: financing alternatives compared, credit impact, dilution, maturity profile, recommendation.

expected_behavior.statement: Every page of the delivered deck is status fit and the package validates.
expected_behavior.check: deck.build.json: every slides[].status == 'fit'; validation_ok == true; `pptx_tools.py validate --render` ok.

expected_behavior.statement: plan.py check passes on the plan the deck was built with, and the build ran with --plan.
Every figure stated in a title, lead-in or callout is computed from the page's own data.
expected_behavior.check: For each stated figure, recompute it from the brief's data; zero mismatches. The agent's figure-check script is present and passes.

expected_behavior.statement: Titles are in the house's register and within its length.
expected_behavior.check: deck.build.json slides[].title: register verdict 'house register'; characters <= guide.titles max; no two-line title the house never wrote.

expected_behavior.statement: Every exhibit was reasoned out before its spec: the plan carries a brief for it that weighs at least two forms and names the house's nearest exhibit or why none is near; the render shows what the brief says the reader must see, with its marks where the claim lives, the way the house marks such places, or the report says why not. No exhibit is justified by a list of chart types.
expected_behavior.check: plan.py check passes on plan.json; for each exhibit, read its brief, open the house page it names (digest crop and record) and the render: the reader sees reader_must_see without arithmetic, the compared value is drawn, and the marks sit where the brief and the house's digest records (marks, in words) put them.

expected_behavior.statement: The section's realised variety is at or above the house's 10th percentile deck, or each warning is explained as a deliberate parallel.
expected_behavior.check: deck.build.json repetition.warnings empty, or each named in the final report with its reason.

expected_behavior.statement: chart_defaults_taken is empty or every remaining entry is named in the report as intended.
The agent looked at every render and wrote located findings (element id, what, the change), and stayed within the build cap.
expected_behavior.check: Transcript: one findings list per review round; builds <= 8 per 5 pages; the delivered build is the best kept, not merely the last.

expected_behavior.statement: The final report separates measured, completed-by-judgement and substituted values, and lists what the user must supply.
No two adjacent pages share an exhibit structure unless declared a deliberate parallel.
expected_behavior.check: deck.build.json repetition.measure.structures: structure V (read from the written file) >= the house's p10 deck (against_house.structures_V), or the repeat is declared; renaming an exhibit in the plan does not move it.

expected_behavior.statement: Each composition name in the plan is honest: two pages that set a table beside a chart carry the same name.
expected_behavior.check: Compare plan compositions with the renders; each page's realised structure (repetition.realised[].structure) agrees with the forms its briefs chose.

expected_behavior.statement: The maturity profile marks the year the new issue lands and the next maturity wall.
expected_behavior.check: An annotation or point fill on the relevant columns.
